name: Anita's Internship
source:
You play as Anita. She needs to do an internship(2 weeks) at a firm and get a letter of recommendation for admission to the university where she dreams of studying. But everything turns out not to be as easy as it always is... Anita has to deal with challenging relationships and people's quirks. Anita also has to deal with a complicated relationship with her stepfather Kelvin, who, in turn, hid the fact that he had a son.

[From [url=https://pigeonpleasure.itch.io/anitas-internship]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演安妮塔。她需要在一家公司实习（两周），并获得一封推荐信，以便进入她梦想就读的大学。但事实证明，一切并不像以前那么容易……安妮塔必须应对充满挑战的人际关系和人们的怪癖。安妮塔还必须处理与继父凯尔文的复杂关系，而继父凯尔文又隐瞒了他有一个儿子的事实。

[来自[url=https://pigeonpleasure.itch.io/anitas-internship]Itch.io[/url]]
